description: Public elephant-foot compensation fades solid contours across configured layers, and reduced solid-infill density ramps by layer.

mutants.description: Keep full first-layer contour correction on each active compensation layer instead of fading it. The public layer-boundary widths must progress across the three-layer ramp.

mutants.old: params.density = 1.0f - (1.0f - elefant_density) * (elefant_layers - (f->layer_id - 1)) / elefant_layers; // Reverse calculation - The higher layer number means the higher density. Counting starts from the second layer.
mutants.description: Apply the configured 50% solid density unchanged to every affected layer rather than ramping toward full density. The measured emitted solid-fill volume ratios must increase over layers 1 through 3.
